summary: usb_hosttest.c and xhci_hosttest.c with nine faults in private copies of rach2/sys/usb/core.c and xhci.c; the test runs both

argv: rm -rf ${WORK}/t && mkdir -p ${WORK}/t/tests/host && cp -R rach2 ${WORK}/t/ && cp -R ${SRC}/. ${WORK}/t/ && cp tests/host/usb_hosttest.c tests/host/xhci_hosttest.c ${WORK}/t/tests/host/ && for t in usb xhci; do ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -g -O1 -Wno-empty-body -ffreestanding -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/lib -I ${WORK}/t/rach2/sys/proc -I utils -I krffs -I tests/host/compat ${WORK}/t/tests/host/${t}_hosttest.c -o ${WORK}/${t}_hosttest || exit; done
s=0; for t in usb_hosttest xhci_hosttest; do ${WORK}/$t || { r=$?; [ $s -ne 0 ] || s=$r; }; done; exit $s

faults.name: doorbells
faults.summary: a doorbell offset past the mapping is not refused, and the range check wraps

faults.name: runtime
faults.summary: a runtime offset past the mapping is not refused, and the range check wraps

lines: slot timeout retains the device and command turn

faults.name: interfaces

faults.name: context

        return;
